items:
Welcome to Cristalino Summer, a beautifully curated Seacrest Beach retreat designed for elevated stays along 30A.

Set between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach, this refined 4 bedroom home was created for guests who value privacy, comfort, and a polished coastal experience.

From the private pool to the rooftop terrace, every space is designed to feel effortless, spacious, and quietly luxurious. Ideal for multi-generational families and elevated group getaways, Cristalino Summer brings together thoughtful design, premium finishes, and the kind of indoor-outdoor living that makes a beach stay feel truly special.

*To protect the home and surrounding community, this property maintains a zero-tolerance policy for disturbances, including those associated with Spring Break.*
What guests love most about their stay:
• Private beach access through Seacrest
• Easy beach arrival using the Seacrest tram (0.01 miles from the home)
• 3-minute walk to the largest pool on the Emerald Coast
• Private pool (with optional heat)
• Rooftop terrace with lounge seating, dining area, fireplace, grill, and TV
• Walkable location near Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach
• Three balconies: third-floor terrace, third-floor swinging chairs, second-floor rocking chairs

What guests appreciate about the home:
• Exceptional cleanliness upon arrival
• Thoughtful starter pack for seamless grocery delivery
• Contact-free check-in with a private access code
• Professionally laundered linens refreshed before every stay
• Non-toxic, elevated cleaning standards throughout the home
• Fully equipped kitchen with premium appliances and a wide range of cookware
• Designed for both casual meals and elevated dining
• Stunning interior where coastal charm meets La Dolce Vita-inspired living
• Upscale finishes, perfect for getting ready before a sunset dinner
• First-floor bedroom for guests who prefer to avoid stairs
• Chef's kitchen with premium appliances
• Newly installed nugget ice machine for pool days
• Beautifully layered interiors designed for relaxed, elevated group stays
• Multiple outdoor living spaces for gathering, dining, and unwinding

Why guests choose to stay with Coastline:
• Customizable beach gear delivery and pickup included for qualifying stays (2–21 nights)
• No need to rent beach chairs, umbrellas, or beach toys separately
• After booking, you'll receive a direct link from VayKLife to select your beach gear
• If selections exceed the included credit, guests simply pay the difference directly to VayKLife

Home care and dehumidification guidelines:
• The home is equipped with dehumidifiers in every bathroom and two whole-home dehumidification systems
• Doors and windows must remain closed while these systems are operating
• Leaving doors open can overwhelm the system and may result in a full system shutdown
• Guests are responsible for following these guidelines to protect the integrity of the home
• Any damage caused by failure to comply may result in repair charges in accordance with the rental agreement

Sleeping arrangements | Sleeps 14:
• Bedroom 1, first floor: Queen bed with shared Jack and Jill bathroom and walk-in shower
• Bedroom 2, second floor: King bed with ensuite bathroom and walk-in shower
• Bedroom 3, second floor: King bed plus custom twin-over-twin bunk with ensuite bathroom and walk-in shower
• Bedroom 4, third floor: Custom bunk room with two twin-over-twin bunks and one full-over-full bunk, with nearby bathroom and shower/tub combo

Pet Policy:
To preserve the condition of this home for all guests, pets are not permitted at this property. Unauthorized pets are a violation of the rental agreement and may result in additional charges, fines, and possible eviction.

Kitchen and dining:
• The kitchen is fully equipped for gathering at home, with a Wolf range, Viking appliances, custom cabinetry, and generous prep space. Indoor dining includes seating for 6, plus additional seating at the breakfast bar.

Comfort and design:
• Cristalino Summer blends upscale finishes with the comfort of a true family retreat. Guests will enjoy Serena & Lily furnishings, hotel-quality mattresses, full-size laundry, independent HVAC systems on each floor, integrated dehumidifiers, motorized blinds, and high-speed Wi-Fi throughout the home.

Outdoor living:
• This home was designed to make the most of coastal indoor-outdoor living. Enjoy multiple balconies, porch swings, inviting lounge spaces, and a rooftop terrace made for slow mornings, sunset dinners, and relaxed evenings by the fire.

Private pool:
• The private pool is reserved exclusively for Cristalino Summer guests and professionally maintained. Pool heat is available for $60 per day and must be arranged before arrival for the full duration of your stay. Guest must follow also Rules and Safety precautions in accordance with the rental agreement and house manual (both sent after booking your reservation).

Seacrest Beach Access & Community Amenities:
• One of the standout perks of staying at Cristalino Summer is access to Seacrest's private beach access and community tram service.
• Getting to the beach is simple. Walk outside, head to the tram stop to the right of the home at the stop sign, and ride straight down to the beach.

Seacrest Wristbands & Parking Passes required:
•Seacrest also requires community wristbands and parking passes for access during your stay. After booking, you will receive a link to secure your amenity packet. *The fee is already included in your reservation total, so there is no additional payment required upon arrival.*

Important lodging policies:
• Primary guest must be 25 or older and remain on site for the duration of the stay
• Only registered guests are permitted unless approved in writing in advance
• No parties, events, or unauthorized gatherings
• No smoking or vaping anywhere on the property
• Quiet hours apply from 10 PM to 7 AM
• Guests must follow all applicable community rules

Additional rules:
• Rental Agreement: A signed rental agreement is required after booking. Arrival instructions, access details, and parking information will be provided once the agreement is completed.
• Exterior Safety: This home is equipped with exterior security cameras for guest and property safety. There are no cameras inside the home. Exterior cameras monitor outdoor entry and pool areas.

If you're looking for a Seacrest stay that feels private, composed, and thoughtfully elevated, Cristalino Summer offers a beautiful home base for your time on 30A.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
